_doc: The prison's three difficulty presets (read by prison_bal.gd `Bal.dm(key)`, picked by the New game card's index 0 to 2). dead_hp: the clear phase's dead hit points; ally_cd: seconds between the allies' shots in the clear phase (a bigger number is slower); wave: the night's wave size (siege); loot: every container's loot of a raid; drain: food and water eaten a day; ruth_deaths: the street deaths of Ruth before the pack is lost (Standard keeps prison_story.json rules.ruth_deaths).

levels.name: Easy
levels.line: Fewer of the dead, fuller shelves
levels.facts: Fewer of the dead come each night (about a quarter fewer). Raids find a third more. The people eat and drink a tenth less. Ruth can be lost in the street four times before the pack is gone.

levels.name: Standard
levels.facts: The nights, the loot and the stores are the ones the game was made for. Ruth can be lost in the street three times before the pack is gone.

levels.name: Hard
levels.line: More of the dead, bare shelves
levels.facts: More of the dead come each night (about a third more). Raids find a quarter less. The people eat and drink a fifth more. Ruth can be lost in the street only twice before the pack is gone.
